title: Question
description: One question from the supervisor to the owner. Runtime file at docs/devteam/run/questions/<id>.json (gitignored, kept on disk as history). Only the supervisor creates questions; only the owner answers them (the supervisor may apply a default). Sessions talk to each other with messages, not questions. See process/questions.md.

ticket.description: ticket the question is on behalf of, if any; the supervisor relays the answer to its worker

context.description: what the answerer needs to know; links to files

default.description: what happens if unanswered; only allowed when the choice is reversible

blocks.description: ticket ids that cannot proceed until answered

answered_by.description: 'owner', or 'supervisor (default)' when a reversible default was applied

recorded_in.description: tracked file where the ruling was copied (spec Rulings, decisions.md)
